fusions.name: Trampling Procession
fusions.desc: A charge across a cone 5 tiles long that deals 14 damage to everything in it and knocks each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Couched Rod
fusions.desc: A strike with the rod held level that deals 30 damage, is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ride at the Van
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh From the Saddle
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
